activity.agents.defaultMessage: {n, plural, =0 {All agents} one {# agent} other {# agents}}
activity.agents.description: A menu button above the Activity tree: which agents it shows (several can be ticked); with none ticked, all.

activity.all.description: The first entry of the Activity tab's Agents and Cards menus: no filter, everything.

activity.cards.defaultMessage: {n, plural, =0 {All cards} one {# card} other {# cards}}
activity.cards.description: A menu button above the Activity tree: which cards it shows (several can be ticked); with none ticked, all.

activity.cardsLabel.description: A label in the Activity tab's details: the cards a session worked on.

activity.cliProcess.description: A process node in the Activity tree that is the agent's own CLI (or its terminal). {pid} is its process id.

activity.closeDetails.description: Tooltip of the button closing the Activity tab's details panel.

activity.collapse.description: A node's close button in the Activity tree (screen readers).

activity.collapseAll.description: Tooltip of the Activity tab's button that closes every node.

activity.column.defaultMessage: {column, select, hold {On Hold} todo {Todo} doing {Doing} review {Review} passed {Passed} done {Done} other {{column}}}
activity.column.description: A card node's second line in the Activity tree: its board column. Use the board's column names.

activity.columnLabel.description: A label in the Activity tab's details: a card's board column.

activity.details.description: The Activity tab's details panel, for screen readers.

activity.empty.defaultMessage: Nothing ran in the last 24 hours. Start an agent to see its work here.
activity.empty.description: The Activity tab when no agent runs and no session was active in the last 24 hours.

activity.emptyFiltered.defaultMessage: Nothing for this filter in the last 24 hours.
activity.emptyFiltered.description: The Activity tab, filtered to an agent or a card, when it has nothing to show.

activity.endButton.description: A button in the Activity tab's details: ends this one process of the agent's, after a confirmation (…).

activity.endDetail.defaultMessage: Only this process ends, and only while it is still the one listed here. What it started keeps running, and the agent may see its command fail.
activity.endDetail.description: Detail of the confirmation before ending one of an agent's processes from the Activity tab.

activity.endFailed.description: An error's title: ending a process from the Activity tab failed.

activity.endMessage.description: The confirmation before ending one of an agent's processes. {label} is what it runs, {pid} its id.

activity.endTitle.description: Title of the confirmation before ending one of an agent's processes from the Activity tab.

activity.ended.description: A notification: the process ({label}: what it ran) was ended from the Activity tab.

activity.endedNode.defaultMessage: Ended · gone at the next refresh
activity.endedNode.description: A node's second line in the Activity tree once its work ended or left the range: it stays in place, dimmed, until a refresh.

activity.expand.description: A node's open button in the Activity tree (screen readers).

activity.expandAll.description: Tooltip of the Activity tab's button that opens every node.

activity.heading.description: The Activity tab's heading: the project's live work as a tree.

activity.hideFinished.description: A checkbox above the Activity tree: shows only running work.

activity.input.description: A heading in the Activity tab's details: the node's input exactly (a prompt, a tool call's input, a command line), with secrets masked.

activity.lastAction.description: A heading in the Activity tab's details: what the node did last (a reply, a tool call's result, an agent's status).

activity.lastActive.description: A label in the Activity tab's details: when a session was last active.

activity.live.description: A button above the Activity tree while it is paused by hand: shows updates as they come again.

activity.liveTip.defaultMessage: Show updates as they come again.
activity.liveTip.description: Tooltip of the Activity tab's Live button (shown while paused by hand).

activity.loadFailed.description: The Activity tab when the project's sessions couldn't be read. {error} is the reason.

activity.loading.description: The Activity tab, or a detail in it, while it loads.

activity.more.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# more session} other {# more sessions}}
activity.more.description: A node in the Activity tree standing for older sessions not shown; clicking it shows them.

activity.noPrompt.description: A turn node in the Activity tree whose prompt has no text (only images, say).

activity.notEnded.defaultMessage: {why, select, notOwn {{label} is no longer one of this agent's processes: nothing was ended.} cli {{label} is the agent's CLI: use Stop to end it.} other {{label} could not be ended: it may still run.}}
activity.notEnded.description: A notification after End Process in the Activity tab when it didn't end it: it had ended or isn't the agent's (notOwn), it is the agent's CLI (cli), or ending it failed. {label} is what it runs.

activity.openCard.description: A button in the Activity tab's details: opens the card.

activity.openSession.description: A button in the Activity tab's details: opens the session's transcript in the Sessions tab.

activity.parentLabel.description: A label in the Activity tab's details: the id of the process that started this one.

activity.pause.description: A button above the Activity tree: holds it as it is (updates wait, counted in the pill) until Live.

activity.pauseTip.defaultMessage: Hold the tree as it is: updates wait until you refresh or go live. It also holds by itself while the pointer is over it, while it scrolls and while a node is selected.
activity.pauseTip.description: Tooltip of the Activity tab's Pause button.

activity.pausedAuto.description: Above the Activity tree while it holds by itself (the pointer over it, a scroll, a node selected) and no update is waiting yet.

activity.pidLabel.description: A label in the Activity tab's details: a process's id.

activity.pill.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# update · Refresh} other {# updates · Refresh}}
activity.pill.description: A pill above the Activity tree while it is paused: how many updates are waiting; clicking it shows them. Keep "Refresh" as the action.

activity.pillTip.defaultMessage: Show the updates that came while it was paused. It stays paused if you paused it.
activity.pillTip.description: Tooltip of the Activity tab's updates pill.

activity.process.description: A process node's second line in the Activity tree. {pid} is its process id.

activity.range.defaultMessage: {range, select, live {Live} 15m {15 min} 1h {1 h} 6h {6 h} other {24 h}}
activity.range.description: A time range button above the Activity tree: Live (running work only), or what was active in the last 15 minutes, 1, 6 or 24 hours. Keep them short.

activity.rangeLabel.description: The Activity tab's time range buttons, for screen readers.

activity.reading.description: Beside the Activity tab's heading while the project's sessions are read (the tree shows running agents meanwhile).

activity.refresh.description: Tooltip of the Activity tab's refresh button: shows what came since, drops what ended, and measures the time range from now.

activity.showAgent.description: A button in the Activity tab's details: shows the agent's terminal.

activity.started.description: A label in the Activity tab's details: when a turn, tool call, task or process started.

activity.state.defaultMessage: {state, select, working {Working} waiting {Waiting for you} failed {Failed or stalled} done {Done} other {Idle}}
activity.state.description: A node's state in the Activity tree: working, waiting for you, failed (or stalled), done, idle.

activity.statusLabel.description: A label in the Activity tab's details: the node's state.

activity.task.defaultMessage: {type, select, subagent {Background subagent} command {Background command} monitor {Monitor} workflow {Workflow} other {Background task}}
activity.task.description: A background task node in the Activity tree: what kind it is.

activity.tools.defaultMessage: {n, plural, =0 {No tool calls} one {# tool call} other {# tool calls}}
activity.tools.description: A turn node's second line in the Activity tree: how many tool calls it made.

activity.turns.description: A session node's second line in the Activity tree: how many turns (a prompt and what followed) it has.
